sa: भङ्कत्वा वनं पादपरत्नसंकुलं हत्वा तु रक्षांसि महान्ति संयुगे। दग्ध्वा पुरी तां गृहरत्नमालिनी तस्थौ हनूमान्पवनात्मजः कपिः।॥
en: And devastating the forest filled with many excellent trees, slaying many a terrible Rākşasa in conflict, and burning down the city of Lankā filled with picturesque houses, the monkey, Hanumān, Wind-god's son, stationed himself there.

sa: तं प्रदाय तु राजेन्द्र कुन्तिभोजमुवाच ह। उषितोऽस्मि सुखं राजन् कन्यया परितोषितः॥ तव गेहेषु विहितः सदा सुप्रतिपूजितः। साधयिष्यामहे तावदित्युक्त्वान्तरधीयत।२२।।
en: O lord of kings, having thus initiated her (into the mantras), he said to Kuntibhoja, “O Monarch, being always duly worshipped and gratified by your daughter I have lived happily in your house. I will now depart". Saying this he vanished away.

sa: विमुञ्चन्तौ शरांस्तीक्ष्णान् संदधानौ च सायकान्। अदृश्यं समरेऽन्योन्यं चक्रतुस्तौ महारथौ॥
en: Then those two mighty car-warriors discharging sharp arrows and placing other arrows on the bow-string, rendered each other invisible in battle.

sa: तेनोपमन्त्र्यमाणाया वधाहेण सपत्नहन्। कालेनेव फलं पक्वं हृदयं मे विदीर्यते॥
en: O slayer of foes, thus addressed by him deserving destruction, my heart is bursting like a fruit ripened in due time.

sa: स मधुर्वीर्यसंपन्नो धर्म च सुसमाहितः। बहुमानाच्च रुद्रेण दत्तस्तस्याद्भुतो वरः॥
en: And by way of honouring him, Rudra conferred a wonderful boon upon Madhu endowed with prowess and ever intent on religion.

sa: दधिकुल्याश्च ददृशुः सर्पिषश्च ह्रदान् जनाः। जम्बूद्वीपो हि सकलो नानाजनपदायुतः॥
en: In that great sacrifice, O monarch, was seen the entire population of Jamvudvipa, with all its kingdoms and provinces, collected together.

sa: बह्वीरपि मतीर्गत्वा मन्त्रिणामर्थनिर्णयः। पुनर्यत्रैकतां प्राप्तः स मन्त्रो मध्यमः स्मृतः॥
en: That one belongs to the middle order in which the counsellors after varied discussion, arrive at unanimity in the long run.

sa: को हन्ता लवणं वीरः कस्यांशः स विधीयताम्। भरतस्य महाबाहोः शत्रुघ्नस्य च धीमतः॥
en: What hero shall slay Lavana? Do you decide this. On whom shall devolve this duty? Whether the mighty armed Bharata or the intelligent Śatrughna shall (do this work?).

sa: अनुभूयेदृशं दुःखमेष राघवनन्दनः॥ प्रेष्ये मयि स्थिते राजन्न भूयः क्लेशमाप्नुयात्।
en: Having suffered such misery, Raghu's son should not be suffered to undergo trouble, while, O king I his servant is by.

sa: प्रहस्य भीमसेनोऽपि कर्ण प्रत्याद्रवद् रणे॥ सायकानां चतुःष्ट्या क्षिप्रकारी महायशाः।
en: Then the highly puissant Bhimasena endued with great activity smilingly sped at Karna in that battle a set of sixty-four arrows.

sa: शङ्कया त्वेतयाहं च दृष्ट्वा त्वामपि राघव। नोपसर्पाम्यहं भीतो भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति॥
en: It was, O Rāghava, in consequence of this fear that when I (first) saw you, I did not come out. This is all the fear that oppresses me.

sa: अथाब्रवीच्चारु मुखं प्रमृज्य धात्रेयिका सारथिमिन्द्रसेनम्॥ जयद्रथेनापहृता प्रमथ्य पञ्चेन्द्रकल्पान् परिभूय कृष्णा। तिष्ठन्ति वानि नवान्यमूनि वृक्षाश्च न म्लान्ति तथैव भग्नाः॥
en: Then rubbing her beautiful face Dhatreyika said to the charioteer Indrasena. “Disregarding the five Indra like princess Jayadratha has carried away Krishna by force. The way pursued by him still exists for the broken branches of the trees have not yet disappeared.

sa: तं भूमौ पतितं दृष्ट्वा विक्षिप्ताम्बरभूषणम्। बभूवुर्व्यथिताः सर्वे हतशेषा निशाचराः॥
en: Seeing him rolling on the earth, with his attire and ornaments scattered about, those nightrangers that survived were overwhelmed with grief.

sa: असकृत्तस्य देवास्तु व्रतविघ्नं प्रचक्रिरे॥ न चास्य नियमाद् बुद्धिरपयाति महात्मनः।
en: The celestials repeatedly attempted for obstructing the observance of his vows. He, however, did not desist from practising his promised vow.

sa: तस्य तं रथमास्थाय हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। प्रममाथ तलेनाशु सह तेनैव रक्षसा॥
en: Thereat, getting at his car, Hanumān-son to the Wind-god with a slap speedily crushed his adversary's vehicle along with the Raksasa.

sa: तं रथस्थमथो दृष्ट्वा सुषेणो वानरोत्तमः गिरिशृङ्गेण महता रथमाशु न्यपातयत्॥
en: Seeing him mounted on his car, Suşena-best of monkeys-taking up a huge crag, swiftly brought his car down to the ground.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं ते समयं कृत्वा न्यवसंस्तत्र पाण्डवाः। वशे शस्त्रप्रतापेन कुर्वन्तोऽन्यान् महीक्षितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having made that rule (amongst themselves), the Pandavas continued to live there (at Khandhavaprastha). They brought under their sway many kings by their prowess of arms.

sa: तस्य त्वं बहुविघ्नश्च नृपते क्रतुरेष स्मृतो महान्। छिद्राण्यस्य तु वाञ्छन्ति यज्ञना ब्रह्मराक्षसाः॥
en: O king, it is said that this sacrifice is full of many obstacles. The Brahma Rakshasas who always harm sacrifices search for holes when this sacrifice is begun.

sa: तं तथा सुकृतं दृष्ट्वा पूज्यमान स्वकर्मसु। प्राद्विषन् कृतसंघाताः पूर्वभृत्या मुहुर्मुहुः॥ धनेन महता
en: Seeing the jackal treated with respect and supported in all his deeds, the old servants of the king, uniting together, began continually to show their hatred towards him.

sa: ह्रियमाणे धने तस्मिन् ब्राह्मणस्य तपस्विनः। अश्रुप्रमार्जनं तस्य कर्तव्यमिति निश्चयः॥
en: Arjuna said : "Alas, this ascetic Brahmana's wealth is being rubbed! It is certainly my duty to dry up his tears.

sa: कतरेण गमिष्यामि भरद्वाजाश्रमं पथा। गहनोऽयं भृशं देशो गङ्गानूपो दुरत्ययः॥
en: By what way shall I go to Bharadvāja's hermitage? These lands watered by the Gangā are dense and hard to track.

sa: तावृष्यमूकस्य समीपचारी चरन् ददर्शाद्भुतदर्शनीयौ। शाखामृगाणामधिपस्तरस्वी वितत्रसे नैव विचेष्ट चेष्टाम्॥
en: Beholding their countenances passing strange, that mighty chief, of monkeys, while ranging near the mount Rșyamuka, became highly terrified and motionless.

sa: तेजः क्षमाः धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता। भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत॥
en: Vigor, forgiveness, firmness, cleanliness, absence of quarrel sameness, freedom from vanity, O Bharata, all these belong to him who is god-like.

sa: पितामहसभायां तु कथितास्ते महर्षयः। सर्वे देवनिकायाश्च सर्वशास्त्राणि चैव ह॥
en: You have said that in the Sabha of the Grandsire are the great Rishis, all the celestials, and all the Shastras.

sa: अर्जुनेन विहीनस्तु यदि नोत्सृजते रणम्। मामुपायान्तमालोक्य गृहीतं विद्धि पाण्डवम्॥
en: Thus, O monarch, I will today with certitude bring under your control Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, with all his followers.

sa: ऊचुश्च सहितास्तत्र साध्विमौ ब्राह्मणर्षभौ। विज्ञायेतां क्वजन्मानौ क्वनिवासौ तथैव च॥
en: They said, "Surely these best Brahmanas are excellent (warriors). Ascertain in what tribe they have been born and when they live.

sa: उल्काश्च जधिरे सूर्यं विकीर्यन्त्यः समन्ततः। वेपथुश्चाभवद् राजन् कैलासस्य महागिरेः॥
en: Many meteors struck the solar disc and then shot in different directions. The prince of mountains, viz., Kailasa, began to tremble.

sa: विसृज्य च महाबाहुर्ऋक्षवानरराक्षसान्। भ्रातृभिः सहितो रामः प्रमुमोद सुखं सुखी॥
en: Having bade adieu to bears, monkeys and Rākşasas the long-armed Rāma began to live happily in the company of his brothers.

sa: ततो मायामयं जालं माययैव विदीर्य सः। साम्बः शरसहस्रेण रथमस्याभ्यवर्षत॥
en: Then dispersing by counter illusion that shower of arrows aided by illusion, Samba showered on his (adversary's) car one thousand arrows.

sa: स हि मामुक्तवांस्तत्र स्मरेः कृच्छ्रेषु मामिति। तं स्मरिष्ये महाबाहो यदि भीष्म त्वमिच्छसि॥
en: He told me, "Mother, think of me (mentally call me) when you will be in difficulty. O mighty-armed Bhishma, if you wish, I can now think of him."

sa: तैः समेत्यार्चितस्तांश्च प्रत्याथ यथा विधि॥ विशश्चाम महाबाहुस्तीरं लब्वेव पारगः। एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु स राजा बभ्रुवाहनः॥
en: Adored by them all and worshipping them in return according to due rites, the mightyarmed hero, accompanied by those princes, took rest like a ship-wrecked man tossed on the waves resting on reaching the shore.

sa: एवमार्ताः पतिं दृष्ट्वा रावणं निहतं भुवि। चुक्रुशुर्बहुधा शोकाद्भूयस्ताः पर्यदेवयन्॥
en: Seeing their husband Rāvaņa thus slain on the earth, they stricken with grief bewailing again and again in sorrow, wept profusely.

sa: त्वं चापि फलभाक् तात तपसः पार्थिवो ह्यसि। फलभाजो हि राजानः कल्याणस्येतरस्य वा॥
en: You shall be a sharer of those penances, o son, for you are the king. Kings are sharers of both auspicious and inauspicious acts done in their kingdom.

sa: शृणु तत्कर्म साहाय्ये यत्कार्यं वचनान्मम। सौवर्णस्त्वं मृगो भूत्वा चित्रो रजतबिन्दुभिः॥ आश्रमे तस्य रामस्य सीतायाः प्रमुखे चर। प्रलोभयित्वा वैदेही यथेष्टं गन्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Listen what you shall have to do at my request in my aid; assuming the shape of a deer having golden skin painted with silvery drops do you proceed to the asylum of Rāma, and ranging at large before Vaidehī do you after captivating her take your wished-for way.

sa: परं हि दानान्न बभूव शाश्वत्तं भव्यं त्रिलोके भवते कुतः पुनः। तस्मात् प्रधानं परमं हि दानं वदन्ति लोकेषु विशिष्टबुद्धयः॥
en: There is nothing so everlasting as a gift. Is there any thing in the three worlds that is more auspicious? It is therefore that they who are greatly intelligent say that there is nothing higher in the three worlds than making gifts.

sa: अग्नेरपत्यं प्रथमं सुवर्ण भूवैष्णवी सूर्यसुताश्च गावः। लोकास्त्रयस्तेन भवन्ति दत्ता यः काञ्चनं गाश्च महीं च दद्यात्॥
en: Gold has been produced from fire, the earth from Vishnu and the kine from the sun. Therefore he who gives away gold, land and kine obtains all the regions of Agni, Vishnu and the Sun.

sa: नैवार्थेन च कामेन विक्रमेण न चाज्ञया। शक्या दैवगतिर्लोके निवर्तयितुमुद्यता॥
en: When the course of accident is about to bring about result-wealth, desire, prowess or command-nothing is capable of with standing it.

sa: को हि धर्मार्थयो नमीदृशं कर्म किल्बिषम्। स्त्रियः प्रियचिकीर्षुः सन् कुर्याद् धर्मज्ञ धर्मवित्॥
en: O cognizant of virtue, what virtuous person conversant in morality, should, seeking the pleasure of his wife, commit such a sinful act devoid of both righteousness and interest?

sa: कैकेयीं मां च तातं च सुहृदो बान्धवांश्च नः। पौरजानपदान् सर्वास्त्रातुं सर्वमिदं भवान्॥
en: Do you rescue all these, Kaikeyī, myself, my father, our friends and adherents, and the whole body of the citizens as well as the inhabitants of the provinces.

sa: लोमश उवाच ऋषेर्वचनमाज्ञाय शर्यातिरविचारयन्। ददौ दुहितरं तस्मै च्यवनाय महात्मने॥
en: Having heard the words of the Rishi, Sharyati without pausing for consideration at once bestowed his daughter on the high-souled Chyavana.

sa: वरुणं देवताः सर्वा यमेत्येदपथाब्रुवन्। यथास्मान् सुरराट्छक्रो भयेभ्यः पाति सर्वदा॥
en: As Indra the king of gods always protects us from every fear, similarly be you the Lord of all the rivers.

sa: शोकार्तस्यापि मे पम्पा शोभते चित्रकानना। व्यवकीर्णा बहुविधैः पुष्पैः शीतोदका शिवा॥ नलिनैरपि संच्छिन्ना हत्यर्थशुभदर्शना। सर्पव्यालानुचरिता मृगद्विजसमाकुला॥
en: Verily conduce to my felicity the pleasant lake Pampã of cool water, scattered with various flowers, covered with lotuses, highly graceful, girt with variegated' woods abounding in voracious animals and frequented by deer and birds.

sa: दिष्ट्या जयसि राजेन्द्र शत्रूञ्छत्रुनिषूदन। दिष्ट्या राज्यं पुनः प्राप्तं धर्मेण च बलेन च।॥
en: 'By good luck, O foremost of kings, you have defeated your enemies, O slayer of foes. By good luck, you have regained your kingdom through virtue and prowess.

sa: तत्र तित्तिरिकल्माषान् मण्डूकाख्यान् हयोत्तमान्। लेभे स करमत्यन्तं गन्धर्वनगरात् तदा॥
en: The victor (Arjuna) took from the city of the Gandharvas as his tribute many excellent horses, called Tittiri, Kalmasha and Manduka.

sa: प्रतिजग्मुश्च ता नद्यो गन्धर्वाश्च यथागतम्। भरद्वाजमनुज्ञाप्य ताश्च सर्वा वराङ्गनाः॥
en: Then taking the permission of Bharadvāja, all the Gandharvas as well as the superb damsels went away as they had come.

sa: तस्मात् त्वमपि राजेन्द्र पूजयैनं यथाविधि। एतत् ते शतशः प्रोक्तं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: O king of kings, therefore duly worship these (Brahmanas). I have thus spoken to you on one hundred subjects. What do you desire to hear from me more?

sa: ये च दुष्कृतकर्माणः पूयं तेषां विधीयते। एवं नदी महाराज सर्वकामप्रदा हि सा॥
en: He who is of evil deed drinks there puss which is the thing that has been ordained for him. O great king, that river fulfills one's all desires.

sa: ततो दिव्यास्त्रविच्छूरो दिव्यान्यस्त्राण्यनेकशः। अयोजयत् स धर्मात्मा दिवसे दिवसे विभुः॥
en: On that occasion did that virtuous souled hero, conversant with celestial weapons, hurl at me, day by day, many celestial weapons.

sa: अयं पुराणः श्लोको हि स्वयं गीतो विभावसो। धात्रा लोकेश्वर यथा कीर्तिरायुर्नरस्य ह॥
en: O Vibhavasu, O lord of the worlds, that fame is the very life of man is evident from the (following) ancient sloka (verse) sung by the creator himself.

sa: सुग्रीवसचिवं कपिम्। अभ्यभाषत वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यज्ञं पवनात्मजम्॥
en: Thus addressed, Saumitri, skilled in speech, welcomed that monkey-Sugrīva's counsellor and son of Pavana.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः॥ नकुलः सहदेवश्च पर्यरक्षन्त सात्यकिम्।
en: Thereupon, king Yudhishthira and Bhimasena and the son of Pandu, (Arjuna) and Nakula and Sahadeva, rushed to the rescue of Satyaki.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्न उवाच श्रूयते श्रूयते चेति क्षम्यते चेति माधव॥ सदानार्योऽशुभः साधु पुरुषं क्षेप्तुमिच्छति।
en: Dhristadyumna said O you of Madhu's race, I have heard you speak. But I forgive you; yourself sinful and impious, you desire to throw odium on the righteous?

sa: सुभद्रा त्वथ शैलेन्द्रमभ्ययैव रैवतम्। दैवतानि च सर्वाणि ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्ति वाच्य च॥ प्रदक्षिणं गिरेः कृत्वा प्रययौ द्वारका प्रति। तामभिदुत्य कौन्तेयः प्रसह्यारोपयद् स्थम्। सुभद्रां चारुसर्वाङ्गी कामबाणप्रपीडितः॥
en: Subhadra, having worshipped that king of hills, Raivataka and the celestials and having been blessed by all the Brahmanas, and having walked round the hill, was returning towards Dwarka. The son of Kunti, struck by the arrows of the god of love, suddenly rushed towards that faultless featured Subhadra and forcibly took her upon his chariot.

sa: सर्वे भवन्तस्थिष्ठन्त महाराजेन संगताः। अहमेको हनिष्यामि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्॥ सुग्रीवं सहनूमन्तं सर्वांश्चैवात्र वानरान्।
en: Do you, all of you, stay here along with the great king. I alone shall slay Rāghava together with Laksmana, and Sugrīva with Hanumān, and all the monkeys.

sa: तस्माद् भीम निवर्तख मम चेदिच्छसि प्रियम्। तथोक्तः सात्यकिं प्राह व्रज त्वं कार्यसिद्धये॥
en: Therefore, O Bhima, turn back, if you, desire to do my good.” Thus spoken to Bhima replied to Satyaki saying “Go you then and be victorious and successful!

sa: शल्य उवाच पश्य कर्णं महाबाहुं संक्रुद्धं पाण्डुनन्दनम्। दीर्घकालार्जित क्रोधं मोक्तुकामं त्वयि ध्रुवम्॥
en: Shalya said Behold, O Karna, the large-armed son of Pandu, worked up with anger. Forsooth he wishes to discharge at you his anger, accumulated for a long time.

sa: सर्वलोकेश्वराः शूरास्तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते। विप्रद्रुता व्यदृश्यन्त प्राकृता इव मानवाः।।२३।
en: Ruling over vast dominions, and all heroic warriors, O ruler of men, flying hither and thither, were slain like ordinary men.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कर्मणां च समस्तानां शुभानां भरतर्षभ। फलानि महतां श्रेष्ठ प्रब्रूहि परिपृच्छतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O best of Bharata's family and the foremost of great men, I wish to know what the fruits are of good deeds! Do you enlighten me.

sa: अथ पापकृतं बुद्ध्या न च पश्यत्यबुद्धिमान्। अकीर्त्याभिसमायुक्तो भूयो नरकमश्नुते॥
en: That king, who is not intelligent, fails to see his own faults. Best with infamy here, he sinks into hell hereafter.

sa: कुशलास्ते नरव्याघ्र येषां कुशलमिच्छसि। श्रीश्च त्वां वृणुते पद्मा युज्यतां चापि ते रथः॥
en: Those of whose welfare you are enquiring after, are, O foremost of men, all well. Śrī seated on the lotus asks for you. Let your car be yoked.

sa: यौवनस्थां तां दृष्ट्वा स्वां सुतां देवरूपिणीम्। अयाच्यमानां च वरैर्नृपतिर्दुःखितोऽभवत्॥
en: Seeing that his daughter (beautiful), as a goddess, attained her puberty and was not courted by suitors, the king became sorry.

sa: अथवा स्वयमप्येष मोक्षं प्राप्स्यति वानरः। गृहीतोऽयं यदि भवेत्रिदशैः सासुरोरगैः॥
en: Or, even when captured by the whole host of gods or Asuras or serpents he is mighty enough to extricate himself.

sa: दुर्मुखाय रथं तूर्ण प्रेषयामास पाण्डवः। तस्मिन् क्षणे महाराज नवभिनतपर्वभिः॥
en: The son of Pandu drove his chariot towards Durmukha. Then in the encounter that followed, with nine shafts of depressed knots.

sa: समागम्य ततो भूयो भ्रातरो बलिनां वरौ। अन्योन्यस्यन्तरप्रेप्सू प्रचक्रातेऽन्तरं प्रति॥
en: Rushing each other and desiring to take advantage of each other's weakness, those two great cousins waited each watching the other.

sa: असत्कारभृतस्तात मम सैन्ये न विद्यते। कर्मणा ह्यनुरूपेण लभ्यते भक्तवेतनम्॥
en: There is none among my troops who has been maltreated. Every one receives his pay and ration, according to his abilities.

sa: विरोधिषु महीपाल निश्चित्य गुरुलाघवम्। न बाधा विद्यते यत्र तंधर्म समुपाचरेत्॥ गुरुलाघवमादायधर्माधर्मविनिश्चये। यतो भूयास्ततो राजन् कुरुष्वधर्मनिश्चयम्॥
en: O ruler of earth, after comparing the opposing virtues and weighing their comparative merits, one ought to espouse that which is not opposing. Where there is no confliction, one should adopt that virtue which preponderates.

sa: तदद्भुततमं श्रुत्वा लोके तस्य महात्मनः। विस्तरेणैव पप्रच्छुः कथान्ते पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: When he concluded, those best of men (the Pandavas) hearing of these extraordinary affairs asked him to narrate it in detail.

sa: भरते ब्रुवति स्वप्नं दूतास्ते क्लान्तवाहनाः। प्रविश्यासह्यपरिखं रम्यं राजगृहं पुरम्॥
en: Bharata was speaking thus when the envoys with their vehicles fatigued, entered the splendid royal residence surrounded by a strong rampart.

sa: तांस्तथा भृशसंरब्धान् पञ्चालान् मत्स्यकेकयान्। सृञ्जयान् पाण्डवांश्चैव द्रोणो व्यक्षोभयद् बली॥
en: Then that puissant Drona began to crush the host of the Panchalas, Matsyas, Kekayas, Srinjayas, the Pandavas, all burning with rage.

sa: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां भीमसेनो महाबलः। शक्तिं जग्राह समरे हेमदण्डामयस्मयीम्॥
en: Thereafter the highly puissant Bhimasena regaining his senses, grasped, in that battle, a dreadful lance of golden staff and iron head.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सत्यजित् वेगवत्तरम्। साश्वं ससूतं विशिखैोणं विव्याघ सध्वजम्॥
en: Thereafter Satyajit having taken up a bow still tougher, pierced Drona, along with his steeds, drivers and standard, with several shafts.

sa: ततः शक्तिं महाघोरां कालरात्रीमिवोद्यताम्॥ प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धः पाण्डवं प्रति सौबलः।
en: After this, Subala's son, worked up with rage threw at the son of Pandu a dreadful dart resembling an imminent death-night.

sa: स बाणैरतिविद्धाङ्गः क्षतजेन समुक्षितः।। रुधिरं परिसुस्राव गिरिः प्रस्रवणं यथा॥
en: With his body entirely covered with arrows and bathed in blood, he began to bleed like a hill overflowing with fountains.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्ये दाशार्हा जातमन्यवः। तत्राजल्पन् मिथः केचित् समाभाष्य परस्परम्॥ ब्राह्मणा एव जायेरन् नान्यो वर्णः कथंचन। को ह्येनं रथमास्थाय जीवेदन्यः पुमानिह॥
en: Secing that extraordinary spectacle, some Dasharhas, filled with anger, addressed one another and began to converse thus; Who else is there on Earth who would live afier having yoke Rukmini to a car! Indeed, let the world be filled with Bralımanas only! Let no other orders take birth here!

sa: तस्मिन् क्षणे बभूवुश्च विना पुष्पफलैर्दुमाः। उद्धृतश्च विना वातं रेणुर्जलधरारुणः॥
en: And at that hour the trees were shorn of fruits and flowers; and without wind there arose dust dusky like clouds.

sa: ब्रह्मास्यतो ब्राह्मणाः सम्प्रसूता बाहुभ्यां वै क्षत्रियाः सम्प्रसूताः। नाभ्यां वैष्याः पादतश्चापि शूद्राः। सर्वे वर्णा नान्यथा वेदितव्याः॥
en: From the mouth of Brahman originated the Brahmanas; from his arms, the Kshatriyas; from his navel, the Vaishyas, and from his feet, the Shudras. All the orders should be considered as differing from one another.

sa: सर्वे वर्णा ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मजाश्च सर्वे नित्यं व्याहरन्ते च ब्रह्मा तत्त्वं शास्त्रं ब्रह्मबुद्ध्या ब्रवीमि सर्वं विश्वं ब्रह्म चैतत् समस्तम्॥
en: All orders of men are Brahmanas. All originate from Brahman. All All men utter Brahma. Helped by an understanding that is derived from and directed to Brahma, I preach this science treating of Nature and Soul. Indeed this whole universe is Brahma.

sa: एष भीमो रणश्लाघी वृतः सोमकपाण्डवैः। अभ्यवर्तत वेगेन द्रोणकर्णी महारथौ॥
en: Yonder does the proud Bhima supported by the Somakas and Pandavas rush furiously against Drona and Karna, those two fierce bow-men.

sa: समेयुश्च महात्मानो युद्धदर्शनकाक्षिणः॥ ऋषयो देवगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च सह चारणैः। समेत्य चोचुः सहितास्तेऽन्योन्यं पुण्यकर्मणः॥
en: And anxious to see the encounter, there came high-souled saints, and celestials, and Gandharvas, and Siddhas, with the Cāranas. And these pious ones assembled, spoke to one another.

sa: शरणं च प्रपन्नानां त्राणार्थं च कुलस्य च। उत्तिष्ठत नरव्याघ्राः सज्जीभवत मा चिरम्॥
en: O foremost of men, arise and arm yourselves without the least delay to rescue those that have sought protection and also to save the honour of our family.

sa: इत्युक्तवाक्यं तद्रक्षः प्रोवाच स्तुतिसंहितम्। मृधे घोरतरं वाक्यं सौमित्रिः प्रहसन्निव॥
en: When that Rākşasa had spoken thus, (Lakş mana). Sumitrā's son, present in that contest, answered him laughing in terrible words, saying.

sa: चतुःशतान् पश्य रथानिमान् हतान् सवाजिसूतान् समरे किरीटिना। महेषुभिः सप्तशतानि दन्तिनां पदातिसादींश्च रथाननेकशः॥
en: Behold, Kiritin, with his powerful shafts, to outstrip in battle four hundred car-warriors with their steeds and drivers and seven hundred elephants, as also numberless infantry and cavalry.

sa: तदिदं वीर संप्राप्तं यन्मया पूर्वमीरितम्। काममोहपरीतस्य यत्तन्न रुचितं तव॥
en: O hero you have come by what I had anticipated and what did not please you who were possessed by delusions.

sa: अथास्य कवचं शुभ्रं जाम्बूनदमयं शुभम्। प्रच्छादयामास शरैः संध्याभ्रमिव मारुतः॥
en: Then as the wind overspread evening clouds, he with his shafts covered his shining and graceful mail entirely made of gold.

sa: पितृदेवातिथिकृते समारम्भोऽत्र शस्यते। अत्रैव हि महाराज त्रिवर्गः केवलं फलम्॥
en: The householder performs acts intended for Pitris, gods, and guests, this mode of life alone, O monarch, contains the threefold objects.

sa: निहन्यमानां पाण्डूनां बलेन मम वाहिनीम्। भूत्वा तद्विजये शतावशक्ताविव पश्यतः॥
en: Though competent to slay the Pandava troops, still you are beholding the slaughter of my troops by them with great in-difference.

sa: न भयं विद्यते तस्मादृषेर्दुर्वाससोऽल्पकम्। तेजसा भवतां भीतः पूर्वमेव पलायितः॥
en: Now you have not the least fear from the ascetic Durvasa; afraid of your ascetic powers, he has already fled away.

sa: स्वस्ति साधय भद्रं ते इत्याज्ञातो ययौ पुरीम्। पाण्डवाश्च महाभाग द्रौपद्या सहिताः प्रभो॥
en: Now go in peace; may good betide you. Thus commanded he repaired to his own city and the Pandavas too, O great king, O lord, long with Draupadi.

sa: आसनं प्राप्य राजा तु मूर्छयाभिपरिप्लुतः। निश्चेष्टोऽतिष्ठत तदा वीज्यमानः समन्ततः॥
en: Placed the throne, the monarch overwhelmed by the influence of the swoon, remained motionless, while he was fanned from all sides.

sa: एवं भित्त्वा महेष्वासः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्। कृत्वाऽवहारं सैन्यानां ययौ स्वशिबिरं नृप॥
en: Thus, O king, having broken the ranks of the Pandava host, the grandsire, withdrawing his force, retired to his own encampment.

sa: अथ मे कृषतः क्षेत्र लाङ्गलादुत्थिता ततः॥ क्षेत्रं शोधयता लब्धा नाम्ना सीतेति विश्रुता। भूतलादुत्थितां सा तु व्यवर्धत ममात्मजा ॥
en: And as I was ploughing the mead, arose a damsel, and as I obtained her while hallowing the field (for sacrifice), she has come to be known by the name of Sītā. And arising from the earth, she grew as my daughter.

sa: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो भीमसेनेन संयुगे। निषसाद रथोपस्थे राजन् दुर्योधनस्तदा॥
en: Then in that conflict, king Duryodhana,, pierced deep and afflicted sore by Bhimasena, squalled down on the terrace of his car.

sa: त्वां पुरस्कृत्य सगर्ण वयं योत्स्यामहे परान्। न हि वैरान्तमनसः स्थास्यन्ति मम सैनिकाः॥
en: Placing you and your followers in our front, we shall fight with our enemies. My troops, impelled by the enmity they bear against the Pandavas cannot be restrained.

sa: शान्तनोरपि संतानं यथा स्यादक्षयं भुवि। तत् ते धर्मं प्रवक्ष्यामि क्षात्रं राज्ञि सनातनम्॥
en: O queen, I shall tell you the everlasting usage of the Kshatriyas, to which recourse may be had in order to prevent the line of Shantanu being extinct.

sa: परित्यजेयं त्रैलोक्यं राज्यं देवेषु वा पुनः। यद् वाप्यधिकमेताभ्यां न तु सत्यं कथंचन॥
en: I can renounce the three worlds, I can renounce the kingdom of heaven or anything that may be greater than the both, but I can never renounce truth.

sa: राज्ये चैवाभिषिच्यस्व भारताननुशाधि च। दारांश्च कुरु धर्मेण मा धर्मेण मा निमन्जी: पितामहान्॥
en: "Install yourself on the throne of the kingdom and rule the domain of the Bharatas. Marry wife according to the rites. Do not sink your ancestors in hell."

sa: तस्मात् त्वां देवदेवेश लोकार्थं ज्ञापयामहे। रक्ष लोकांश्च देवांश्च शक्रं च महतो भयात्॥
en: O god of gods, it is for this we tell you what is our present trouble. Save the worlds, the celestials and Indra also from this great fear.

sa: ततः पर्वतमुत्पाट्य द्विविदः प्लवगर्षभः। दुद्राव गिरिशृङ्गाभं विलम्ब इव तोयदः॥
en: Then uprooting a crag, Dvivide-foremost of monkeys-resembling an extended mass of clouds rushed against (Kumbhakarņa) having the aspect of a mountain-summit.

sa: बलाच्च तेन प्रतिवार्यमाणैः। प्रधर्षणे त्यक्तभयैः समेत्य प्रकृष्यते चाप्यनवेक्ष्य दोषम्॥
en: They were greatly excited with drink, and being prevented forcibly by Dadhimukha, they giving up all fear, began to pull him.

sa: ततो वृषभमास्थाय पार्वत्या सहितः शिवः। वायुमार्गेण गच्छन्वै शुश्राव रुदितस्वनम्॥
en: It so fell that, journeying with Parvati, Siva, riding his bull through the serial regions, heard the sounds of weeping, on

sa: अस्या देव्या मनस्तस्मिंस्तस्य चास्यां प्रतिष्ठितम्। तेनेयं स च धर्मात्मा मुहूर्तमपि जीवति ॥
en: She has her mind fixed in him, and he in her and it is for this that she and the virtuous-souled (Rāma) have been still maintaining their being.

sa: अयं सौम्य नलो नाम तनयो विश्वकर्मणः। पित्रा दत्तवरः श्रीमान्प्रीतिमान्विश्वकर्मणः॥ एष सेतुं महोत्साहः करोतु मयि वानरः। तमहं धारयिष्यामि यथा ह्येष पिता तथा॥
en: O mild one, this one is named Nala, son to Viśvakarmā. He has received a boon from his sire. Visvakarma's son is well pleased with you. Let this monkey, surcharged with exhuberant spirits, build a bridge over me. I will hold that up. This one is as his sire.

sa: मनोरथः स्यादिति चिन्तयामि तथापि बुद्ध्यापि वितर्कयामि। किं कारणं तस्य हि नास्ति रूपं सुव्यक्तरूपश्च वदत्ययं माम्॥
en: Methinks this is but a phantom of the mind. And thinking this I still behold the same. But an imaginary object can never have a form. And I still find a distinct form addressing me.

sa: तं सिंहमिव संक्रुद्धं रामं दशरथात्मजम्। सर्प सुप्तमहो बुद्ध्वा प्रबोधयितुमिच्छसि॥
en: Alas! you wished to awake Rima, son to Daśaratha-knowing full well that le resembles an enraged lion or a sleeping serpeni.

sa: ततस्तु संक्रुद्धतरः सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः॥ मोक्षितं चात्मनो दृष्ट्वा प्रहारं तेन रक्षसा। स ददर्शान्तरं तस्य विरूपाक्षस्य वानरः॥
en: Finding his aim baffled and himself struck in return by the Rākşasa, Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, was excited with anger. And the monkey-chief was now on the look-out for an opportunity to strike Virüpākşa.

sa: अनुपायेन कर्माणि विपरीतानि यानि च। क्रियमाणानि दुष्यन्ति हवींष्यप्रयतेष्विव ॥
en: But those actions that are done without deliberation, like to clarified butter poured in an impure sacrifice, conducted only to harma.

sa: राक्षस्यस्त्रिजटा चापि शासनात्तमुपस्थिताः। ता उवाच ततो हृष्टो राक्षसी राक्षसाधिपः॥
en: Thereat the Raksasi-Trijata and otherspresented themselves at his command. And then the lord of Rākşasas, delighted addressed then the Raksasis, saying.

sa: ततो गत्वा वयं युद्धं दास्यामस्तस्य यत्नतः। जेष्यामो यदि ते शत्रूनोपायैः कार्यमस्ति नः॥
en: We, marching out, shall battle with Rāma, putting forth our uttermost. And if we succeed in securing victory, no expedient need we resort to (or bringing Sītā round).

sa: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा अगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः। उवाच रामं प्रहसन्पितामह इवेश्वरम्॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāghava, the ascetic Agastya, having six sorts of wealth, laughing said, like to Brahmā, speaking to Rudra

sa: ततः प्रहस्तं निर्यान्तं भीमं भीमपराक्रमम्। गर्जन्तं सुमहाकायं राक्षसैरभिसंवृतम्॥ ददर्श महती सेना वानराणां बलीयसाम्। अभिसंजातघोषाणां प्रहस्तमभिगर्जताम्॥
en: That mighty army of strong monkeys, wrought up with wrath, and roaring at Prahasta, saw him dreadful and of terrific prowess and huge-bodied, surrounded on all sides by the Raksasas, and setting up roars, marching.

sa: चारुपल्लवपत्राढ्यं यं सीता स्वयमास्थिता। प्रवृद्धः शिंशपावृक्षः स च तेनाभिरक्षितः॥
en: And that overgrown Sinsapă tree, affluent with elegant foliage, under which Sītā herself has (always rested), has been spared by him.

sa: अयोध्यां गन्तुमिच्छामः सर्वात्रयतु नो भवान्। मुधुक्ता विचरिष्यामो वनान्युपवनानि च॥
en: We wish all to go to Ayodhyä. Do you take us. We shall all range with delight at forests and gardens.

sa: ततो रुद्राः सहादित्या वसवो मरुतोऽश्विनौ। संनद्धा निर्ययुस्तूर्णं राक्षसानभितः पुरात्॥
en: Thereupon having issued out of the city, Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, Maruts and Asvins well armed with mails, appeared before the Raksasas.

sa: रामहस्ताद्दशग्रीवः शूरो दत्तमहावरः। इदं भयं महाघोरं समुत्पन्नं न बुद्ध्यते।२६।।
en: Does not the Ten-necked hero, who has obtained boons (from Brahmă) perceive that a mighty disaster shall befall him from Råma?

sa: सुखसुप्ता त्वया सार्धं जानकी पूर्वमुत्थिता। वायसः सहसोत्पत्य विददार स्तनान्तरम्॥
en: Sleeping happily with you, Janaki one day awoke before, and in the meantime, a crow wounded her breast with its beaks.

sa: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन शृणु राम वचो मम। पश्यन्तु सकला लोकात्स्वां मां चैव रणाजिरे॥
en: What is the use of speaking more, O Rāma, do you hear my words. Let all the people behold your as well as my prowess in the battle-field.

sa: कृतं हि सुमहत्कर्म यदन्यैर्दुष्करं रणे। ऋक्षराजेन तुष्यामि गोलाङ्गुलाधिपेन च॥ अङ्गदेन कृतं कर्म मैन्देन द्विविदेन च। युद्ध केसरिणा संख्ये घोरं संपातिना कृतम्॥
en: By you has been achieved a mighty feat incapable of being done by another in battle. And pleased am I with the king of bears, and the lord of Golãngulas; and Angada has quit himself nobly, as also Mainda and Dvivida. And Kesarin and Sampāti have both faught terribly.

sa: आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रास्ते सुग्रीवेण महात्मना। आसन्नं द्वारमासाद्य युध्यध्वं च प्लवंगमाः।॥
en: The foremost monkeys were directed by the high-souled Sugriva, saying, “You monkeys, do you fight, approaching the gate lying at hand.

sa: तेषां संनह्यमानानां सिंहनादं च कुर्वताम्। शर्वरी राक्षसेन्द्राणां रौद्रीव समपद्यत॥
en: An' in consequence of the foremost Rakşasas preparing for fight, and emitting roars, that night appeared like the Fatal Night itself.

sa: ततः कुम्भः समुत्पत्य सुग्रीवमभिपात्य च। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना॥
en: Then springing up, and bringing Sugriva down, Kumbha, transported with wrath dealt a blow on his chest, like to the levin.

sa: ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यो भीमदर्शनाः। पुनः परुषमेकार्थमनर्थार्थमथाब्रुवन्॥
en: And approaching Sītā those grim-visaged demons again addressed her with words rude and rough.

sa: विचित्य गिरिदुर्गाणि नदीप्रस्रवणानि च। अनासाद्य पदं देव्याः प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Ranging the mountain strongholds, rivers and fountains and not finding your reverence, we were ready to do away with our existence.

sa: ननद युधि सुग्रीवः स्वरेण महता महान्। पोथयन्विविधांश्चान्यान्ममन्थोत्तमराक्षसान्।।।। ममर्द च महाकायो राक्षसान्वानरेश्वरः। युगान्तसमये वायुः प्रवृद्धानगमानिव ॥
en: The heroic Sugrīva emitted terrible roars in the conflict and assailed the heroic Rakşasas and many others. The huge-bodied monkey-chief crushed the Rakşasas like to the wind uprooting the trees at the time of dissolution.

sa: स तु प्रहाराभिहतः सुग्रीवेण महागजः। अपासर्पद्धनुर्मानं निषसाद ननाद च॥
en: Being assailed greatly by Sugrīva that huge elephant proceeded a little within the range of the bow and roared and died.

sa: तस्मात्पुरा दुहितरं गृहीत्वा वनमागतः। इयं ममात्मजा राजंस्तस्याः कुक्षौ विवर्धिता॥
en: From then, taking my daughter, I have come to this wood. This, O king, is my daughter, grown in her womb.

sa: सारणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्। बलमादिश्य तत्सर्वं शुको वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Having heard the words of Säraņa, who had described the forces (of the monkeys), Suka, addressed Rāvana, lord of Rākşasas, saying.

sa: त्वदाननरसस्याद्य पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिनः। सुधामृतरस्स्येव कोऽद्य तृप्ति गमिष्यति॥
en: Who shall be satisfied with drinking the nectar of your mouth smelling like lotus?

sa: स्थितो मुहुर्त तेजस्वी स्थैर्य कृत्वा महामतिः। आजघान च संक्रुद्धस्तलेनैवामरद्विषम्॥
en: And staying for a moment and calling up fortitude, that magnanimous one administered a slap to the foe of the immortals.

sa: ततः स कपिशार्दूलस्तेन वाक्येन तोषितः। सीतामुवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः॥
en: Hearing those words, that foremost of monkeys, skilled in speech, was greatly delighted and again addressed Sītā in the following words,

sa: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता वानराणां महाचमूः॥ दुमशैलप्रहाराणां योद्धं समुपतिष्ठताम्। तेषां युद्धं महारौद्रं संजज्ञे कपिरक्षसाम्॥ रामरावणयोरर्थे समभित्यक्तदेहिनः । सर्वे ह्यतिबलाः शूराः सर्वे पर्वतसंनिभाः॥
en: The mighty army of monkeys was seized with trepidation at that sound. And then there took place a mighty encounter of the Rākṣasas and the monkeys equipped staying in fight with trees and rocks, who had given up all concern for their selves in behalf of Rāma and Rävaņa.

sa: मत्करोत्सृष्टवज्रेण हनुरस्य यथा हतः। नाम्ना वै कपिशार्दूलो भवित्त हनुमानिति॥
en: Since his chin got wounded by the thunderbolt released by me, so this tiger among Mongoloids will be known as Hanuniãn.

sa: नहि पश्यामि सदृशं चिन्तयन्ती प्लवंगम। आख्यानकस्य भवतो दातुं प्रत्यभिनन्दनम्॥
en: O monkey I do not perceive any such thing which I can confer upon you in return, for this pleasant news.

sa: न चैतत्कर्म रामस्य श्रद्दधामि चमूमुखे। सर्वतः समुपेतस्य तव तेनाभिभर्षणम्॥
en: I do not believe that your destruction, who had always been crowned with success, before the forces, is work of Rāma.

sa: विभीषणं च सुग्रीवो दृष्ट्वा वानरभीषणम्। ऋश्रराजं महात्मानं समीपस्थमुवाच ह॥
en: And Sugriva, seeing Vibhisana, capable of inspiring fear in the monkeys, spoke to the highsouled sovereign of bears, who stood by.

sa: संपृष्टो राजपुत्रेण रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। विभीषणो महाप्रज्ञः काकुत्स्थमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Accosted by the king's son-Rāma of untiring deeds-the exceedingly wise Vibhīşaņa said to Kakutstha.

sa: प्रकृत्या ह्येष तेजस्वी कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः। अन्येषां राक्षसेन्द्राणां वरदानकृतं बलम्॥
en: The exceedingly powerful Kumbhakarņa is mighty by nature: the strength of other redoubtable Rākşasas is owing to boons obtained by them.

sa: सर्वथा कृतकार्योऽसौ हनूमान् नात्र संशयः। नह्यस्याकृतकार्यस्य नाद एवंविधो भवेत्॥
en: Hanumān has succeeded completely. There is no doubt about this. If he were unsuccessful, he would not utter shouts as these.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु राघवस्यैतदुत्थायोत्थाय वानराः। प्रणम्य शिरसा पादौ निर्जग्मुस्ते महाबलाः॥
en: And hearing the words of Rāghava, the highly powerful monkeys, one by one, saluted Rāma, touching his feet and went away.

sa: स सायकार्तो विपरीतचेताः कूजन्पृथिव्यां निपपात वीरः। तं वीक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं विसंज्ञं नेदुः प्रहृष्टा युधि यातुधानाः॥
en: Thereat, agonised by the shaft, that hero, with his senses bewildered, dropped down to the ground with shrieks. And seeing him down on the earth bereft of his senses, the Yātudhānas were filled with rejoicing.

sa: नृशंस इति मां राम वक्ष्यन्ति मनुजा भुवि॥ श्रुत्वा तस्यागुणान्सर्वे वक्ष्यन्ति सुकृतं पुनः।
en: O Rāma, perhaps people of this earth will call me cruel but they will again recognise my act as good when they will hear of his vicious deeds.

sa: न चाप्यस्य कपेर्घाते कंचित् पश्याम्यहं गुणम्। तेष्वयं पात्यतां दण्डो यैरयं प्रेषितः कपिः॥
en: Nor do I see any good that may likely accrue to us from the slaying of this monkey. Let your vengeance descend those that have despatched the monkey.

sa: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टौ राक्षसौ शुकसारणौ। जयेति प्रतिनन्द्यैनं राघवं धर्मवत्सलम्॥ आगम्य नगरी लङ्कामव्रतां राक्षसाधिपम्।
en: Thus directed (by Rama), those Raksasas, Śuka and Säraņa, having saluted the righteous Raghava with 'Victory!,' came (back) to Lanka and spoke to the lord of Rākşasas, saying.

sa: तैस्तैरनिष्टोपगमैरजस्रं यत्र कुत्र कः। मतिमान्मानुषे लोके युद्धेन प्रणयी भवेत्॥
en: What sensible person can set his heart on slaying human beings, who are everywhere beset with a perennial stream of evils.

sa: यद्यप्येष तु वृत्तान्तो वैदेह्या गतितो मम। समुद्रपारगमने हरीणां किमिवोत्तरम्॥
en: This tidings you have related to me touching Vaidehī; but what are the monkeys to do next avout crossing the sea?

sa: देवाश्च दैत्याश्च निशाचरेन्द्र गन्धर्वविद्याधरनागयक्षाः। रामस्य लोकत्रयनायकस्य स्थातुं न शक्ताः समरेषु सर्वे ॥
en: nor Neither deities nor Daityas, nor the foremost night-rangers, nor Gandharvas and Vidyādharas, nor Nāgas, nor Yakşas, can stay in fight against Rāma—the leader of these three worlds.

sa: तां प्रविश्य महामायां प्राप्तां पशुपतेः पुरा। प्रविवेश सुसंरब्धस्तत्सैन्यं समभिद्रवत्॥
en: Having resorted to the illusory powers, conferred upon him yore by Pasupati he entered into the enemies' camp and belaboured them.

sa: यत्राहमाभिः क्रूराभी राक्षसीभिरिहार्दिता । जीवामि हीना रामेण मुहूर्तमपि दुःखिता॥
en: Or else I would not have lived for a moment, separated from Rama and oppressed by the Raksasis as I am.

sa: तेन शब्देन महता प्रवृद्धेन समन्ततः। त्रिकूटः कन्दरः कीर्णः प्रव्याहरदिवाचलः॥
en: On that sound attaining dimensions on all sides, it seemed as if the mount Trikuta, containing numerous caverns, had been speaking.

sa: स विध्यमानः सहसा सहमानस्तु ताञ्छरान्॥ कुम्भस्य धनुराक्षिप्य बभञ्जेन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम्। अवप्लुत्य धनुः शीघ्रं कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्॥ अब्रवीत्कुपितः कुम्भं भग्नशृङ्गमिव द्विपम्।
en: Suddenly attacked, he bearing those arrows, seized Kumbha's bow resembling in resplendence the very bow of Indra. And swiftly bounding up and performing that feat difficult of being achieved, he, exceedingly enraged, addressed Kumbha resembling an elephant shorn of his tusks, saying.

sa: सप्तभौमाष्टभौमैश्च स ददर्श महापुरीम्। स्थलैः स्फटिकसंकीर्णैः कार्तस्वरविभूषितैः। तैस्तैः शुशुभिरे तानि भवनान्यत्र रक्षसाम्॥
en: He saw that splendid city containing sevenstoried and eight-storied edifices, studded with crystal and adorned with gold. And the dwellings of the Rākṣasas were embellished with these (ornaments).

sa: ताडितो माणिभद्रस्य मुकुटे प्राहरद्रणे। तस्य तेन प्रहारेण मुकुटं पार्श्वमागतम्॥
en: And on being thus hit, (Rāvana) struck at Manibhadra's head: and at that stroke his crown was depressed at one side.

sa: प्र.क्षेणं रथं कृत्वा समाहूय निशाचरः। संचोदयायास शीघ्रं वै रथमावह॥
en: And going round the chariot and addressing the charioteer that night-ranger (Makarāksa) said, O charioteer, do you soon drive the chariot.

sa: शतैः शतसहस्रश्च कोटिभिश्चायुतैरपि। वारणाभैश्च हरिभिर्ययौ परिवृतस्तदा॥
en: He marched, surrounded by hundreds and thousands, Koțis and Ayutas of monkeys resembling elephants.

sa: बद्धौ त तौ वीरशये शयानौ ते वानराः संपरिवार्य तस्थुः। समागता वायुसुतप्रमुख्या विषादमार्ताः परमं च जग्मुः॥
en: When they had been bound and had laid themselves down as become heroes, the monkeys stood around them-and, conversing with one another, they, headed by the son of the Wing, were seized with extreme sorrow.

sa: अविन्ध्यो नाम मेधावी विद्वान् राक्षसपुङ्गवः। धृतिमाञ्छीलवान् वृद्धो रावणस्य सुसम्मतः॥ रामात् क्षयमनुप्राप्तं रक्षसां प्रत्यचोदयत्। न च तस्य स दुष्टात्मा शृणोति वचनं हितम्॥
en: There is a leading, steady, old, intelligent and educated Rākşasa, gifted with a good character, named Avindhya and highly respected of Rāvana who told him that the destruction of the Rākṣasa race would proceed from Rāma, but the vicious-souled one paid no attention to his wellmeaning words. is my

sa: दुरात्मा पृच्छयतामेष कुतः किं वास्य कारणम्। वनभङ्गे च कोऽस्यार्थो राक्षसानां च तर्जने ॥ मत्पुरीमप्रधृष्यां वै गमने किं प्रयोजनम्। आयोधने वा किं कार्यं पृच्छयतामेष दुर्मतिः॥
en: Ask this wicked-minded one, whence is he? And what led him to ravage the grove, and what was his object in brow-beating the Rākşasas? And what has been his purpose in entering my metropolis incapable of being subdued; and what for did he also fight (with my retainers?) Do you ask the wicked-minded one about this.

sa: स काञ्चनविचित्रेण किरीटेन विराजता। भूषणैश्च बभौ मेरुः प्रभाभिरिव भासयन्॥
en: Adorned with a crown plated with wrought gold' and (other) ornaments he looked like the Meru swimming in its own splendour.

sa: विक्लवानां ह्यबुद्धीनां राज्ञां पण्डितमानिनाम्। रोचते त्वद्वचो नित्यं कथ्यमानं महोदर॥
en: O Mahodara, what you say is ever acceptable only to kings that are incompetent, and foolish, pluming themselves on their knowledge.

sa: उपधाय भुजं तस्य लोकनाथस्य सत्कृतम्। कथं नामोपधास्यामि भुजमन्यस्य कस्यचित्॥
en: Having laid my head on the beautiful arms of that lord of men, how shall I place it again on another's?

sa: बलवन्तोऽस्त्रविदुषो नानाप्रहरणा रणे। जघ्नुर्वानरसैन्यानि राक्षसाः क्रोधमूर्छिताः॥
en: Raksasas, possessed of strength; equipped with various weapons, transported with passion, slew the monkey-forces.

sa: लक्ष्मणस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो भ्रातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। ब्राह्ममस्त्रं प्रयोक्ष्यामि वधार्थ सर्वरक्षसाम्॥
en: Thereupon Lakşmaņa, being excited with wrath, spoke to his brother, saying-"To slay all the Rākṣasas shall I discharge today Brahma weapon.'

sa: अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते न चिरात्सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि वः। अरावणमरामं वा जगद्रक्ष्यथ वानराः॥
en: You monkeys, this I swear to you-this very hour not long after you will see this world without Rāvaņa or Rāma.

sa: तस्य ते रथसंयुक्ता हया विक्रमवर्जिताः। चरणैराकुलैर्गत्वा दीनाः सास्रमुखा ययुः॥
en: The course of the steeds was thus slackened and they began to move slowly and poorly with their heads drooping down.

sa: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा त्वरमाणो विभीषणः॥ संस्कारयितुमारेभे भ्रातरं रावणं हतम्।
en: Hearing the words of Rāghava, Vibhīşaņa hastened on and began to make arrangements for the cremation of his slain brother Råvana.

sa: अद्य मत्कार्मुकोन्मुक्ताः शरा निर्भिद्य रावणिम्। लङ्कामभिपतिष्यन्ति हंसाः पुष्करिणीमिव ॥
en: Today the shafts discharged from my bow, piercing Ravana's son, shall fall into Lanka, even as swans drop into a tank.

sa: आपतन्तं च संप्रेक्ष्य कुम्भो वानरयूथपम्॥ ध्रुवौ विव्याध बाणाभ्यामुल्काभ्यामिव कुञ्जरम्।
en: Seeing him spring up, Kumbha pierced that monkey-leader on the ground with shafts, even as one assail an elephant with fire-brands.

sa: ततः शरानायततीक्ष्णशल्यान् सुपत्रिणः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खान्। मुमोच वीरः परवीरहन्ता सुसंततान् वज्रसमानवेगान्॥
en: Thereupon the heroic (Indrajit)-slayer of foes-began to discharge incessantly shafts, large, sharp, well-feathered, painted in gold and swift-coursing like to thunder.

sa: दृष्ट्वा गृहवरं रम्यं दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्। कस्येदं भवनं रम्यं मेरुमन्दरसंनिभम्॥
en: Beholding that excellent house the highly powerful Rävaņa thought within himself “Whose is this beautiful house, resembling the summit of Meru?"

sa: स गत्वा दूरमध्वानमुपर्युपरि सागरम्। संस्थितो ज़म्बरे वाक्यं सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्॥ सर्वमुक्तं यथादिष्टं रावणेन दुरात्मना।
en: And, proceeding far over the deep and stationing himself at the welkin, he spoke to Sugrīva all the words with which he was addressed by the vicious-souled Ravana.

sa: स तस्य रथनिर्घोषं ज्यास्वनं कार्मुकस्य च। निशम्य हरिवीरोऽसौ सम्प्रहृष्टतरोऽभवत्॥
en: And hearing the sound of his car and the twang of his bow, that heroic monkey attained an excess of delight.

sa: अथवा वासवेन त्वं धर्षितोऽसि महाबल। वासवस्य तु का शक्तिस्त्वां द्रष्टुमपि संयुगे॥ महाबलं महावीर्यं देवशत्रु महौजसम्।
en: Or you have been slain by Väsava (no) what power has he got to face you in the conflict gifted with great strength, prowess and energy and an enemy of the celestials as you are?

sa: राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु. तच्छ्रुत्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः। हर्षान्नादं विमुञ्चन्वै निष्क्रान्तो वरुणालयात्॥
en: Hearing these words and spreading his own name the lord of Rākṣasas expressing sign of joy, issued out of Varuna's abode.

sa: गतः खलु महाराजो ब्रह्मलोकं जलेश्वरः। गान्धर्वं वरुणः श्रोतुं यं त्वमाह्वयसे युधि ॥
en: O great king Varuņa's sons are slain and the lord of waters, whom you are inviting for battle, has gone to the region of Brahma, to hear songs.

sa: सागरस्योत्तरे तीरेऽब्रुवं ते वचनं तथा। यथा संदेशमक्लिष्टं सान्त्वयश्लक्ष्णया गिरा॥
en: Repairing to the northern shore of the sea, I, pacifying (the monkeys) with mild speech, communicated your tidings clearly (to Sugrīva).

sa: देशकालोपपन्नं च कार्य कार्यविदां वर। सफलं कुरुते क्षिप्रं प्रयोगेणाभिसंहितम्॥
en: So this action of Vibhīşana is not out of place or season. When accomplished it shall redound to his own interest.

sa: हनूमन्तं कपि व्यक्तं मन्यते नान्यथेति सा। अथोवाच हनूमांस्तामुत्तरं प्रियदर्शनाम्॥
en: She then took him for a real monkey and none else. Thereupon Hanumān again spoke to her, having a comely presence,

sa: तस्मिन्संधीयमाने तु राघवेण शरोत्तमे। सर्वभूतानि संत्रेसुश्चचाल च वसुंधरा ॥
en: That excellent arrow being mounted on his bow by Rāghava all the animals were stricker. with fear and the earth shook.

sa: प्रगृह्या विपुलां घोरां महीधरसमं शिलाम्। चिक्षेप च महातेजास्तद्वधाय हरीश्वरः॥
en: And taking up a huge and dreadful crag resembling a mountain, the monkeys-king hurled it with great vehemence to slay him.

sa: अप्रमादश्च कर्तव्यो युवाभ्यां नित्यमेव हि ॥ प्रकृत्या राक्षसाः सर्वे संग्रामे कूटयोधिनः। शूराणां शुद्धभावानां भवतामार्जवं बलम्॥
en: you should always be on your guard. By nature the Rākşasas have cunning shifts in fight and you, who are heroic and of a pure spirit, can but rely on your simplicity alone for strength.

sa: प्रणम्य दैवतेभ्यश्च ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च मैथिली। बद्धांजलिपुटा चेदमुवाचाग्निसमीपतः॥
en: Bowing to the celestials and Brāhmaṇas, Maithilī, with folded hands, spoke before the fire.

sa: तृणवद्भाषितं तस्य तं च नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम्॥ अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही ह्यशोकवनिकां गता।
en: But she regarded that foremost of Rākşasas and his words as straw. And Vaidehi was placed in the forest of Asoka.

sa: राज्यं प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ लङ्कायां नेह संशयः। रावणः सह पुत्रेण स्वकामं नेह लप्स्यते॥
en: O you cognisant of righteousness, you will here in Lankā obtain empire: no doubt of this; and Răvaņa along with his sons will be disappointed in their expectations.

sa: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवः सहलक्ष्मणः। सेनां निवेशयत्तीरे सागरस्य दुमायुते॥
en: Hearing the words of Rama, Sugrīva along with Lakşmana, encamped the army on the brink of the ocean, covered with trees.

sa: इत्युक्तः सारथिस्तेन ययौ यत्र स मारुतिः। वहन्परमदुर्धर्षं स्थितमिन्द्रजितं रथे॥
en: Thus accosted by him, the charioteer went where the Wind-god's offspring was, carrying the exceedingly invincible Indrajit seated on the car.

sa: प्रतिकूलं ववौ वायू रणे पांसून्समुत्किरन्। तस्य राक्षसराजस्य कुर्वन्दृष्टिविलोपनम् ॥
en: And in that battle-field the unfavourable wind began to blow raising dust and obstruction the vision of the king of Rākşasas.

sa: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञातं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। विश्रब्धा भव वैदेहि श्वो गमिष्यस्यसंशयम्॥
en: Whereto replied Rāma of unwearied actions, saying 'so be it.' Believe me, O Vaidehi, that you shall undoubtedly go there to-morrow.

sa: राजन्नापदयुक्तेयमागता प्राकृताज्जनात्। हृदि नैव त्वया कार्या त्वं वधिष्यसि राघवम्॥
en: O king, you must not think that this calamity, coming from an ignoble person is not insignificant. You shall slay Rāghava.

sa: कामं लोकास्त्रयः सेन्द्राः ससुरासुरमानवाः॥ भवतामग्रतः स्थातुं न पर्याप्ता रणाजिरे।
en: These three worlds combined, with Indra, celestials and mortals, are incapable of long staying before you in the field of battle.

sa: ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गः प्रगृह्य च महातरुम्। प्रहस्तस्योरसि क्रुद्धो विससर्ज महाकपिः॥
en: Then the mighty monkey, with his person drenched in blood, wrought up with passion, discharged a tall tree at Prahasta's breast.

sa: वृक्षेभ्यः पतितैः पुष्पैरवकीर्णा पृथग्विधैः। रराज वसुधा तत्र प्रमदेव विभूषिता॥
en: And strewn with several masses of blossoms loosened from the trees, the Earth appeared breateous like a damsel dight with ornaments.

sa: ददृशुश्च महात्मानं हयपृष्ठप्रतिष्ठितम्। चरन्तं हरिसैन्यैषु विद्याधरमहर्षयः॥
en: The Vidyadharas and Maharsis saw that highsouled one mounted on horseback, ranging the monkey-ranks.

sa: दिव्याङ्गरागां वैदेहीं दिव्याभरणभूषिताम्। इह सीतां शिरः स्नातामुपस्थापय मा चिरम्॥
en: Do you speedily bring Sītā here-the daughter of the king of Mithila-bathed, sprinkled with celestial pasted and adorned with celestial ornaments.

sa: शयनान्यत्र नारीणां शून्यानि बहुधा पुनः। परस्परं समाश्लिष्य काश्चित् सुप्तावराङ्गनाः॥
en: There were many bedsteads belonging to fair ones, remaining vacant; and at some places excellent women were sleeping touching each other.

sa: दृष्टमन्तःपुरं सर्वं दृष्टा राक्षसयोषितः। न सीता दृश्यते साध्वी वृथा जातो मम श्रमः॥
en: Having searched the inner apartment through, and seen the wives of the Rākṣasa, I do not see the chaste Sită. Therefore vain is the trouble that I take.

sa: ततो रथस्थमालोक्य सौमित्री रावणात्मजम्। वानराश्च महावीर्या राक्षसश्च विभीषणः॥ विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्लाघवात्तस्य धीमतः।
en: Seeing Răvaşa's son seated on the car, the son of Sumitrā and the exceedingly powerful monkeys and the Raksasa-Vibhisana-were highly amazed at the lighthandedness of that intelligent one.

sa: रामोऽपि रेमे तैः साधं वानरैः कामरूपिभिः। राक्षसैश्च महावीक्षैश्चैव महाबलैः॥
en: He, too also spent his time happily with monkeys assuming shapes at will, the highly powerful Rakşasas and the mighty bears.

sa: तत्र मन्दाकिनी रम्या नदीनामुत्तमा नदी. काञ्चनैः सूर्यसंकाशैः पङ्कजैः संवृतोदका॥ कुमुदैरुत्पलैश्चैव अन्यैश्चैव सुगन्धिभिः।
en: There flowes the Mandākini best of streams, with her water covered with golden lotuses resembling suns, as also with lilies and blue lotuses and various other fragment flowers.

sa: देवसागरमक्षोभ्यं शस्त्रैः समवगाह्य च। जिता द्विषो ह्यप्रतिमास्तन्नो मृत्युकृतं भयम्॥
en: With arms plunging into the sea of celestials, we have conquered our unrivalled enemies. Therefore, we have no fear touching death.

sa: तैर्बाध्यमानास्त्रिदशाः सर्षिसङ्घाः सचारणाः। त्रातारं नाधिगच्छन्ति निरयस्था यथा नराः॥ अथ ते विश्वकर्माणं शिल्पिनां वरमव्ययम्। ऊचुः समेत्य संहृष्टा राक्षसा रघुसत्तम॥
en: And like to men abiding in hell, the celestials, chāraṇas and hosts of sages, being harassed (by Raksasas), did not find any deliverer. And then, O foremost of the Raghus, the Raksasas, assembled together, joyfully said to the undeteriorating Viśvakarmá—prince of artist.

sa: तथा चेन्द्रजितो वेश्म जगाम हरियूथपः। जम्बुमालेः सुमालेश्च जगाम हरिसत्तमः॥
en: And thus, next into that of Indrajit, and that foremost of monkeys went to the mansion of Jambumāla, and of Sumāla,

sa: ततः सहस्रयूथाश्च कोटियूथाश्च यूथपाः। कोटियूथशताश्चान्ये लङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा॥
en: Then leader of thousands and koțis and hundreds of koțis began to scale Lanka.

sa: प्रणम्य दैवतेभ्यश्च ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च मैथिली। बद्धांजलिपुटा चेदमुवाचाग्निसमीपतः॥
en: Bowing to the celestials and Brāhmaṇas, Maithilī, with folded hands, spoke before the fire.

sa: वानराणां शरीरैस्तु राक्षसानां च मेदिनी। बभूवातिचिता घोरैः पर्वतैरिव संवृता॥
en: The earth was covered quite with the terrible bodies of monkeys and Rākşasas; and it looked as if covered with mountains.

sa: तमश्च लोकमावत्रे दिशश्च न चकाशिरे। प्रतिचुक्षुभिरे चाशु सरांसि सरितस्तदा॥
en: And darkness covered the world, and the cardinal points became invisible. And at once the watery expanses and rivers were agitated.

sa: पूर्व तु भरते स्नाते लक्ष्मणे च महाबले। सुग्रीवे वानरेन्द्रे च राक्षसेन्द्रे विभीषणे॥ विशोधितजटः स्नातश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः। महाहवसनोपेतस्तस्थौ तत्र श्रिया ज्वलन्॥
en: At first, Bharata, the highly powerful Laks maņa, Sugrīva the lord of monkeys, and Vibhīs aņa the lord of Rākşasas bathed. Thereupon shorn of his matted hairs, bathed, with paste excellent garlands and precious clothes on, he appeared there shining in grace.

sa: सबाष्पशोकाभिहता समीक्ष्य तौ भ्रातरौ देवसुतप्रभावौ। वितर्कयन्ती निधनं तयोः सा दुःखान्विता वाक्यमिदं जगाद॥
en: With her eyes shedding plentiful tears, she seeing those brothers, endowed with god-like prowess, concluded them to be dead; and overwhelmed with grief, spoke as follows. as as

sa: देवाश्च सर्वे तुष्यन्ति ग्रहणाच्छ्वणात्तथा। रामायणस्य श्रवणे तृप्यन्ति पितरः सदा॥
en: The celestials shall be greatly delighted for reading or hearing this story of Rāma and the progenitors shall be always pleased.

sa: तद्वानरबलं दृष्ट्वा रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। कृत्वा विकोशं निस्त्रिंशं मूर्ध्नि सीतामकर्षयत्॥
en: Beholding that monkey host, Ravana's son became beside himself with ire and unsheathing his weapon Nistrinsha, caught her by the hair.

sa: स्वप्नो ह्यद्य मया दृष्टो दारुणो रोमहर्षणः॥ रक्षसां च विनाशाय भर्तुरस्या जयाय च।
en: In truth I have seen a dismal dream capable of making one's hair stand on end; (presaging) destruction to Rākşasas and victory to the husband of this one.

sa: स तस्य मध्ये भवनस्य संस्थितो महद्विमानं मणिरत्नचित्रितम्। प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालकृत्रिम ददर्श धीमान् पवनात्मजः कपिः॥
en: Staying in that mansion, that intelligent monkey, the offspring of the Wind-god, beheld that splendid aerial car, beauteous with excellent jewels, and furnished with windows of burnished gold.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा तादृशं सैन्यं दशग्रीवो निशाचरः। हर्षनादान्बहून्कृत्वा स क्रोधादभ्यभाषत॥
en: And finding his forces in that plight, Daśagrīva set up full many a cheerful shout and in wrath began to speak.

sa: तस्यां स फलके खङ्गं निजघान ततोऽङ्गदः। यज्ञोपवीतवच्चैनं चिच्छेद कपिकुञ्जरः॥
en: Then hitting at (Akampana's) shoulder-blade, that powerful monkey-Angada hewed him in twain, his blow going obliquely down like the sacred thread.

sa: प्रविष्टः स तु रक्षेन्द्रो दृष्ट्वा तां चारुहासिनीम्। जिघृक्षुः सहसा साध्वी सिंहासनसमास्थिताम्॥ विनापि सचिवैस्तत्र रावणो दुर्मतिस्तदा। हस्ते ग्रहीतुमन्विच्छन्मन्मथेन वशीकृतः॥ सुप्तमाशीविषं यद्रावणः कालनोदितः। अथ सुप्तो महाबाहुः पावकेनावगुण्ठितः॥ ग्रहीतुकामं तं ज्ञात्वा व्यपविद्धपटं तदा। जहासोचैर्भृशं देवस्तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसाधिपम्॥ तेजसा सहसा दीप्तो रावणो लोकरावणः। कृत्तमूलो यथा शाखी निपपात महीतले॥ पतितं राक्षसं ज्ञात्वा वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्। उत्तिष्ठ राक्षसश्रेष्ठ मृत्युस्ते नाद्य विद्यते॥ प्रजापतिव
en: Having entered there without any councillor the vicious Rāvana, the lord of Räkşasas, on beholding that chaste damsel with sweet smiles seated on a royal seat, being possessed by desire, grew anxious to hold her by the hand, as one, under the influence of death, catches a sleeping serpent. Beholding that lord of Rākşasas with loose cloth and understanding him as desirous of holding (her) the deity, having huge arms, asleep and enveloped with flames, laughed aloud. And searched suddenly by his energy, Ravana, the dread of all people, fell down on earth like to an up-rooted tree. Beholding that Raksasa fallen he said the following words: “Rise up, O foremost of Raksasas, you shall not meet with death today; you shall live and be protected, O Raksasa, by the great Patriarch's boon. Do you the

sa: तस्याथ नर्दमानस्य दीप्यमानस्य तेजसा। बभूव रूपं दुर्धर्षं दीप्तस्येव विभावसोः॥
en: The form of that one roaring and flaming up in energy, was irresistible, like to the appearance of a flaming fire.

sa: तस्यास्तु दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी प्राप्तस्त्वद्भवनं विभो। मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रो वानरो हनुमानहम्॥ रामदूतं च मां विद्धि सुग्रीवसचिवं कपिम्। सोऽहं दौत्येन रामस्य त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः॥
en: To behold her I have come here, O hero. I am the monkey Hanumān, the own begotten son of Māruta. Do you know me as Rāma's ambassador and the minister of Sugrīva. And on Rāma's embassy have I come here before you.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु सा कन्या कृताञ्जलिरथाब्रवीत्। आत्मप्रभावेण मुने ज्ञातुमर्हसि मे मतम्॥ किं तु मां विद्धिब्रह्मर्षे शासनात्पितुरागताम्। कैकसी नाम नाम्नाहं शेषं त्वं ज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: Thus addressed, the girl, with joined hands, said, 'O ascetic, you are competent to get at my intent by virtue of your own power. Yet, O Brahmarși, know me as having come here at the mandate of my sire. My name is Kaikasī. The rest do you read yourself.

sa: धूम्राक्षं निहतं दृष्ट्वा हतशेषा निशाचराः।। त्रस्ताः प्रविविशुर्लङ्कां वध्यमानाः प्लवंगमैः॥
en: Seeing Dhūmrākṣa slain, those night-rangers that survived the carnage, in extreme agitation began to pour into Lankā, attacked by the monkeys.

sa: धूम्राक्षं निहतं दृष्ट्वा हतशेषा निशाचराः।। त्रस्ताः प्रविविशुर्लङ्कां वध्यमानाः प्लवंगमैः॥
en: Seeing Dhūmrākṣa slain, those night-rangers that survived the carnage, in extreme agitation began to pour into Lankā, attacked by the monkeys.

sa: संचचाल प्लवंगानां बलमुच्चैर्ननाद च। जवेनाप्लुत्य च पुनस्तद्बलं रक्षसां महत्॥
en: Thereat that array of Räkşasas vehemently sprang forward before the force of the foe, like to insects plunging into a flame.

sa: तस्याश्चास्य महद्भीमं वर्धते मम भक्षणे। न तु मां सा नु बुबुधे मम वा विकृतं कृतम्॥
en: And her huge and dreadful mouth extended wide to eat me up. She did not understand me, (Understand that I was able to assume any shape at pleasure) nor that I had altered my shape.

sa: तत्र चार्धप्रदीप्तानां गृहाणां सागरः पुनः। भाभिः संसक्तसलिलश्चलोमिः शुशुभे ध्रुवम्॥
en: The light of half-burnt houses, again, falling on the restless ripples of the sea, made it wear an extremely beautiful aspect.

sa: ततो वनं तत् परिभक्ष्यमाणं दुमांश्च विध्वंसितपत्रपुष्पान्। समीक्ष्य कोपाद् दधिवक्त्रनामा निवारयामास कपिः कपीस्तान्॥
en: Thereupon beholding all the fruits eaten up and the trees divested of leaves and flowers, the monkey Dadhimukha and worked up with ire and attempted to prevent them.

sa: तस्मात् तिष्ठेत् सदा पूर्वो पश्चिमां चैव वाग्यतः। ये न पूर्वामुपासन्ते द्विजाः संध्यां न पाश्चिमाम्॥ सर्वोस्तान् धार्मिको राजा शूद्रकर्माणि कारयेत्। परदारा न गन्तव्या सर्ववर्णेषु कर्हिचित्॥
en: Hence one should controlling speech, say his prayers regularly at the two twilight's. As regards those Brahmanas who do not say their prayers at the two twilight's, a righteous king should set them to perform such deeds as are ordained for the Shudras. Persons of every caste should never have sexual congress with other people's wives.

sa: तस्मात् कालप्रतीक्षोऽहं स्थितोऽस्मि शुभलक्षण। सुग्रीवस्य नदीनां च प्रसादमभिकाङ्क्षयन् ॥
en: Therefore I shall, O Laksmana, live here, awaiting the pleasure of Sugrīva and the clear currents of the rivers (the autumn).

sa: सर्वकामफलास्तत्र केचिद् वृक्षा जनाधिप। अपरे क्षीरिणो नाम वृक्षास्तत्र नराधिप॥
en: O king, some of the trees produce fruits as one desires to cat. There are some trees that are called "Milk-yielding".

sa: ददौ राजा सुसंहृष्टः कन्याधनमनुत्तमम्। दत्त्वा बहुविधं राजा समनुज्ञाप्य पार्थिवम्॥ प्रविवेश स्वनिलयं मिथिलां मिथिलेश्वरः। राजाप्ययोध्याधिपतिः सह पुत्रैर्महात्मभिः॥ ऋषीन् सर्वान् पुरस्कृत्य जगाम सबलानुगः।
en: Having given divers kinds of articles, that king, the lord of Mithila, bidding adieu to the monarch (Dasaratha), re-entered his own capital. And the master of Ayodhyā accompanied with his high-souled sons, and headed by the saints in a body, started on the journey, followed by his own army.

sa: न ते पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतो वा पश्यामि दुर्योधन रक्षितारम्। अपेहि युद्धात् पुरुषप्रवीर प्राणान् प्रियान् पाण्डवतोऽद्य रक्ष॥
en: O Duryodhana! As no guard is seen either in front or back of you. Hence, O chivalrous man! Immediately depart from the battle-field and save your life before you die in the hands of Arjuna.

sa: प्रययौ सदनं राजा गाङ्गेयस्य यशस्विनः। अन्वीयमानः सततं सोदरैः परिवारितः॥
en: Thus honored by the Kurus, that highly puissant king of the Kurus repaired to the son of Ganga of illustrious fame.

sa: ब्राह्मणार्थेषु यत् सिद्धमन्नं तेषां महात्मनाम्। तद् वरनरेभ्यः प्रददुः सुरागन्धसमन्वितम्॥
en: The Vrishnis, mixing with wine the food that had been cooked for great Brahmanas, gave it away to monkeys an apes.

sa: वर्तमाने तथा तस्मिन् निर्मर्यादे भयानके। भीष्ममासाद्य पार्थानां वाहिनी समकम्पत॥
en: In that fearful and terrible battle in which no consideration was shown, the Pandavas (at last) began to waver before Bhishma.

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। छादयामास समरे तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥ तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम शिलानां प्लवनं यथा। निश्चेष्टस्तद् रणे राजञ्छिखण्डी समतिष्ठत॥
en: Then he covered him suddenly who was approaching with straight arrows. This was indeed wonderful. We then, O king, beheld a wonderful spectacle like the flying of rocks. And Shikhandin remained inactive in that battle.

sa: परितुष्टं मुनिं ज्ञात्वा गन्धर्वी मधुरस्वरम्। उवाच परमप्रीता वाक्यज्ञा वाक्यकोविदम्॥
en: Thereupon, concluding that the ascetic was gratified, the Gandharvi, cognizant of words, exceedingly delighted, sweetly addressed that one versed in speech.

sa: यथा त्रस्यन्ति भूतानि सर्वाण्यशनिनिः स्वनात्। तथा शङ्खप्रणादेन वित्रेसुस्तव सैनिकाः॥
en: At the blare of their conchs, your troops took right even as creatures become frightened at the rumbling of the thunder.

sa: शतशः पुण्डरीका मे गोसवाश्चरिताः प्रभो। क्रतवो वाजपेयाश्च तेषां फलमवाप्नुहि॥
en: "O Lord the sacrificial rites Pundarika, Gosava and Vajapeya have been performed by me by hundreds; get the merits of these.

sa: इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणी भृशकोपिता। गङ्गायां नीयतामेष पुत्रा इत्येवमब्रवीत्॥
en: Bhishma said: Having heard these words, the Brahmana lady became exceedingly angry and said, “O sons, throw him into the Ganges.”

sa: तं तु कृच्छ्रगतं दृष्ट्वा पञ्चत्वगतमानसम्। भृशानुरक्तमेधावी न भविष्यति लक्ष्मणः॥
en: Seeing him come under misery, with his mind expiring, the intelligent Laksmana, firmly attached (to Rāma), shall also cease to exist.

sa: रक्षिणश्चात्र विहिता नूनं रक्षन्ति पादपान्। भगवानपि विश्वात्मा नातिक्षोभं प्रवायति॥
en: And warders, directed there to, forsooth, protect the trees, and that worshipful Soul of the universe does not breathe here vigorously.

sa: स तान् दृष्ट्वा निपतितान् कदने भृशदुः :खितः। बभूवातीव कौरव्यः प्राप्तकालं चकार ह॥
en: The Kuru prince, seeing them lying killed all around, became exceedingly cheerless. He, however did what required to be done in view of that which had taken place.

sa: पुत्राश्चान्धकवृष्णीनां सर्वे पार्थमनुव्रताः। ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया: वैश्याः शूद्राश्चैव महाधनाः॥ दश षट् च सहस्राणि वासुदेवावरोधनम्। पुरस्कृत्य ययुर्वजं पौत्रं कृणस्य धीमतः॥
en: The children of the Andhaka, and the Vrishni races, all followed Arjuna. The Brahmanas and Kshatriyas and Vaishyas, and rich Shudras, started keeping before them the sixteen thousand women who had formed Vasudeva's harem and Vajra, the grandson of the intelligent Krishna.

sa: ततो यष्टिप्रहरणा दस्यवस्ते सहस्रशः। अभ्यधावान्त वृष्णीनां तं जनं लोप्पहारिणः॥
en: Then those robbers, numbering by thousands, and armed with clubs, rushed a towards the procession of the Vrishnis for looting them.

sa: सा त्रियामा तदार्तस्य चन्द्रमण्डलमण्डिता॥ राज्ञो विलपमानस्य न व्यभापत शर्वरी।
en: But although crested with the lunar disc, the night failed to bring comfort to the king, distressed, and indulging in grief.

sa: दण्डकारण्यमेषोऽहं गच्छाम्येव हि सत्वरः। अविचार्य पितुर्वाक्यं समा वस्तुं चतुर्दश॥
en: I shall, not even judging the propriety of my father's words, speedily repair to the forest of Dandaka for fourteen years.

sa: ये चाश्रमेषु वै धर्माश्चतुर्धा विदिता मुने। वैदिकानि च सर्वाणि विद्धि सर्वं मदात्मकम्॥
en: Those fourfold courses of duty which, O ascetic, are known to attach to the (four) modes of life, and all the Vedic duties, have me for their soul.

sa: शूरश्च कृतविद्यश्च जितक्रोधः क्षमापरः। कथं कमलपत्राक्षो मया रामो विवास्यते।।।।
en: How shall I banish Rāma having eyes resembling lotus' petals, who is heroic, and accomplished and of subdued anger, and forgiving.

sa: पौरुषेण तु यत् कार्यं तत् कर्तारौ स्व पावक। करणानि समर्थानि भगवन् दातुमर्हसि॥
en: O Agni, we are ready to do what is possible to be done by manliness and prowess. O illustrious one, but you should give us the proper means.

sa: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत। श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः॥
en: The faith of man, O Bharata is according to his own nature. A man may be full of faith, and as his faith is so he will be.

sa: दृष्ट्वाऽऽपतन्तं सहसा तु नागं धृष्टद्युम्नः स्वरथाच्छ्रीघ्रमेव। गदां प्रगृह्योग्रजवेन वीरो भूमिं प्रपन्नो भयविह्वलाङ्गः॥
en: Beholding the animal rushing forcibly at him, the heroic Dhrishtadyumna, taking up a mace, quickly leaped down on the Earth from his car, his limbs benumbed with fear.

sa: मया खलु तदेवेदं रोषदोषात् प्रदर्शितम्। प्रथितं त्रिषु लोकेषु कपित्वमनवस्थितम्॥
en: I have through my culpable passion furnished an illustration of the reckless monkey-nature, which is well known over the three worlds.

sa: कुम्भकर्णः शुभं दिव्यं प्रतिपेदे वरासमम्। स तदासनमाश्रित्य कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः॥ संरक्तनयनः क्रोधाद्रावणं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
en: Kumbhakarņa seated himself on a shining and superb seat. And seating himself on that seat, the wondrous powerful Kumbhakarna, with his eyes reddened in wrath, addressed Ravana, saying.

sa: तच्छूलवर्ष सुमहद् गदाशक्तिसमाकुलम्। अनिशं सृज्यमानं तैरपतन्मद्रथोपरि॥
en: That continuous discharge of spears together with maces and clubs fell upon my car.

sa: ते तेनावेक्षिताः कुम्भाः पूर्णा एवाभवंस्ततः। ततः प्रक्षालनं कृत्वा समधिश्रित्य बाहुकः॥ तृणमुष्टिं समादाय सवितुस्तं समादधत्। अथ प्रज्वलितस्तत्र सहसा हव्यवाहनः॥
en: Those vessels, whenever looked at by him (Bahuka), became at once filled with water. Thereupon Bahuka washed them and set himself to cooking. Then again he grasped a handful of grass and held it to the sun, where suddenly fire blazed up.

sa: अतीव चान्यत् सुमहदाश्चर्यं दृष्टवत्यहम्। यत् स पुष्पाण्युपादाय हस्ताभ्यां ममृदे शनैः॥ मृद्यमानानि पाणिभ्यां तेन पुष्पाणि नान्यथा। भूय एव सुगन्धीनि हृषितानि भवन्ति हि। एतान्यद्भुतलिङ्गानि दृष्ट्वाहं दुतमागता॥
en: I have marked another wonder, which was extraordinarily great, that he took some flowers in his hands and pressed them slowly. Although these flowers were pressed by him with the hands, yet they, instead of losing their original forms, became more fragrant and beautiful than before. Observing those marks of wonder, I have hastily come here.

sa: उपदेशः कृतोऽनेन पक्षिणा मम संयुगे॥ शत्रूणां क्षपणे युक्तः प्राप्तः कालश्च मे मतः।
en: He said to him, "This owl teaches me a lesson in battle. Bent as I am upon the destruction of the enemy, the time for action is come.

sa: अयद्भुतानि ते दृष्ट्वा वासुदेवपुरोगमाः। दुर्योधनस्य पूजां तु दृष्ट्वा व्रीडामुपागमन्॥
en: Beholding these good signs, and this worship offered to Duryodhana, the Pandavas, with Vasudeva at their head, were put to shame.

sa: सर्वक्षपितकोशं च स त्वमभ्युपपद्य माम्। त्रायस्वेमां पुरीं लङ्कां बालवृद्धावशेषिताम्॥
en: Do you, favouring me, whose exchequer is empty, save this city of Lanka, having only young folks and the aged left.

sa: उमा जिज्ञासमाना वै कोऽयमित्यब्रवीत् सुरान्॥ असूयतश्च शक्रस्य वज्रेण प्रहरिष्यतः।
en: Uma then asked the gods who that child was. The malevolent Indra then tried to strike him with the thunder bolt.

sa: अखिल भारतं चेदं चकार भगवान् मुनिः॥ आकर्य भक्त्या सततं जयाख्यं भारतं महत्।
en: It should be read by Brahmanas, by kings, and by women big with children. He who desires Heaven attains to Heaven; and he who desires victory achieves it.

sa: निगदामि यथायुक्तं पुराणाश्रयसंयुतम्। भृगुर्महर्षिर्भगवान् ब्रह्मणा वै स्वयंभुवा॥ वरुणस्य क्रतौ जातः पावकादिति नः श्रुतम्। भृगोः सुदयितः पुत्रश्च्यवनो नाम भार्गवः॥
en: I shall properly relate, O great Rishi, the history of this race, as it is in the Puranas. We are told that great Bhrigu was begotten by selfexisting Brahma from the fire at Varuna's sacrifice. Bhrigu had a beloved son, named Chyavana.

sa: कथं राज्ञः पिता भूत्वा स्वयं राजा च संजय। प्रेष्यभूतः प्रवर्तेयं पाण्डवेयस्य शासनात्॥
en: Having been the father of a king and a king myself, O Sanjaya, how shall I pass my days as a slave obeying he commands of Pandu's son.

sa: पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे पित्रा ते मम राघव। रक्षितेन वरौ दत्तौ सशल्येन महारणे॥
en: Foremerly in a great war between the gods and Asuras, your father, being wounded with shafts was tended by me for which he conferred upon me two boons.

sa: ते हयाश्चोदितास्तेन सूतेन परमाहवे। अवहन् मां भृशं राजन् मनोमारुतरंहसः॥
en: Those horses fleet as the mind or the wind, urged by that charioteer, took me, O king, to the great battle.

sa: ततो द्विजातीन् सर्वांस्तान् दक्षिणाभिरतोषयत्। पूजिताश्चापि ते राज्ञा ततो जग्मुर्यथागतम्॥
en: King Janamejaya then pleased all the Brahmanas with profuse presents. Thus adored by the king, they returned to their respective abodes.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजामृषिदत्तां प्रतापवान्। रामं दाशरथिं रामो जामदग्न्योऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Accepting that homage rendered to him by the saints, that puissant one, Jamadagni's son, Rāma, addressed Rāma, the son of Dasaratha.

sa: ते वयं भवता रक्ष्या भवद्विषयवासिनः। नगरस्थो वनस्थो वा त्वं नो राजा जनेश्वरः॥
en: And we, being in your dominions, ought to be protected by you. Whether living in the city or in the woods, you, lord of men, are our sovereign.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् मरुद्गणवृतः प्रभुः। जगाम भवनं विष्णोरक्षरं शाश्वतं पदम्॥
en: Bhishma continued 'Having said these words, the divine and powerful Narayana, in the forın of Indra, accompanied by the Maruts, repaired to his eternal abode of endless felicity.

sa: बलैः समग्रैर्युधि मां रावणं जित्य संयुगे। विजयी स्वपुरं यायात् तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्॥
en: But if (Rāma) himself together with all his forces, conquering Ravana and (recovering me) in battle, returned victorious to his own city, this would be worthy of himself.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु ते सर्वे दुर्योधनवचस्तदा। सर्वतो रथवंशेन गाङ्गेयं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Hearing these words of Duryodhana, all those warriors surrounded on all sides with a host of cars, the son of Ganga.

sa: शकाः किराता दरदा बर्बरास्ताम्रलिप्तकाः। अन्ये च बहवो म्लेच्छा विविधायुधपामयः॥
en: And yonder Sakas and Kiratas and Daradas and Barbaras and Tamraliptakas and numerous other Mlechchas armed with diverse weapons are staying.

sa: ततो रामस्य सत्कृत्य विधिना पावकोपमाः। आजहुस्ते महाभागाः सललं धर्मचारिणः॥
en: Then, having received Rāma respectfully according to scriptural prescription, those virtuous ones of eminent piety, resembling fire, procured water (for Rāma).

sa: इन्द्र उवाच मातापित्रोर्हि शुश्रूषा कर्तव्या सर्वदस्युभिः। आचार्य गुरुशुश्रूषा तथैवाश्रमवासिनाम्॥
en: Indra said All the robber tribes should serve their parents, their preceptors and other elders and hermits living in the forest.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच एतद् वाक्यं नलो राजा दमयन्तीं समाहितः। उवाचासकृदातॊ हि भैमीमुद्दिश्य भारत।॥
en: Brihdashva said: O descendant of Bharata's race! addressing the daughter of Bhima, king Nala sorely afflicted with grief, carefully spoke these words to Damayanti, over and over again.

sa: विदर्भराजस्तत्र त्वां पूजयिष्यति मानद। तेन त्वं पूजितो राजन् सुखं वत्स्यसि नो गृहे॥
en: O bestower of honor! there, the king of the Vidharbhas shall worship you. Thus held in great respect by him, you shall live in happiness in our residence.

sa: ततः स ब्रह्मणः पुत्र आद्यो ह्यषिवरस्त्रितः। उत्ततारोदपानाद् वै पृश्निगर्भानुकीर्तनात्॥
en: That foremost of Rishis, viz., Trita, the spiritual son of Brahma, having called on me thus, was saved from the pit.

sa: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनाम्। संदधौ स्थानमन्यत्र वरयामास दुर्वसा ॥ एकेनांशेन वत्स्यामि पूर्णोदासु नदीषु वै। चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्दर्पघ्नी कामचारिणी॥
en: Hearing the words of the high-souled celestials she divided herself into four parts and wishing for a separate habitation said:-By one portion, I shall at my pleasure, live in rivers full of water during rains and shall obstruct people from going there.

sa: त्रीणि तेजांसि नोच्छिष्ट आलभेत कदाचन॥ अग्निं गां ब्राह्मणं चैव तथा ह्यायुर्न रिष्यते।
en: One should never touch these three things, while one is in an impure state, viz., fire, a cow and a Brahmana. By observing this rule one lives long.

sa: यदि तस्यामभिप्रायो भार्यात्वे तव जायते। शीघ्रमुद्भियतां पादो जयार्थमिह दक्षिणः॥
en: If it is your purpose to have her for your wife, at once stretch forth your right leg. for attaining success.

sa: वृषपर्वोवाच यं काममभिकामासि देवयानि शुचिस्मिते। तत् तेऽहं सम्प्रदास्यामि यदि वापि हि दुर्लभम्॥
en: Vrishaparva said : O Devayani, O lady of sweet smiles, whatever you desire to possess, however difficult it may be to get, I am willing to give you.

sa: ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पेश्यश्च विविधाः परे। आनकाश्चाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्॥
en: Their conchs, drums, Peshis and cymbals were sounded by all, which created a fearful din all over the field of battle.

sa: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन। देवतानामृषीणां च मध्ये सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
en: I have never before spoken an untruth, and an untruth I shall never speak. Here in the midst of the gods and the Rishis I say the truth.

sa: तथा समुद्रो नृपते पूर्णो मृष्टस्य वारिणः। ब्राह्मणैरभिशप्तश्च बभूव लवणोदकः॥
en: The Ocean, O king, that was full in former days of crystal water, cursed by the Brahmanas, become saline in taste.

sa: शीघ्रं तौ रूपसम्पन्नावनुज्ञातौ महर्षिणा। प्रस्थितौ धृतचापासी सीतया सह राघवौ॥
en: And permitted by the Maharşi, the Rāghavas furnished with grace, equipped with bows and scimitars, swiftly set out along with Sītā.

sa: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे भीमसेनं महाबलम्। दुःशासनस्य रुधिरं पीत्वा नृत्यन्तमाहवे॥
en: When you will see Bhimasena of great strength in the field dancing in this great battle drinking the blood of Dushasana,

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं वैशम्पायनकीर्तितम्। व्यासाज्ञया समाज्ञातं सर्पसत्रे नृपस्य हि॥
en: I have now told you everything that Vaishampayana described, at the command of Vyasa, to the king at his snake sacrifice.

sa: प्रदास्यन्ति नृपा सदा देवमनुष्याणामसुराणां च गालव। कादिक्षता रूपतो बाला सुता मे प्रतिगृह्यताम्॥
en: This one resembling the daughter of a god and the promoter of every virtue and who is ever solicited by the gods, human beings and Asuras, O Galava,

sa: संस्तुत्य पृथिवीं देवीं वासुदेवः प्रतापवान्। पप्रच्छ भरतश्रेष्ठ मां त्वं यत् पृच्छसेऽद्य वै॥
en: The powerful Vasudeva, O excellent prince of Bharata's race, after singing the praises of the goddess Earth, accosted her about this very subject that you have required about.

sa: इन्द्रस्य भवनं गत्वा सरोषः सिंहिकासुतः। अब्रवीद्धृकुटिं कृत्वा देवं देवगणैर्वृतम्॥
en: And repairing to the house of Indra, Sinhika's son, in wrath and with frowns, said to him encircled by the celestials.

sa: तेषां न तावन्निर्वृत्तं वर्तते तु त्रयोदशम्। अज्ञातवासो बीभत्सुरथास्माभिः समागतः॥
en: The thirteenth year is still going on and not yet complete. Bibhatsu, who is living in disguise, has come to us.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य च तां कन्यां गालवः सह पक्षिणा। पुनर्द्रक्ष्याव इत्युक्त्वा प्रतस्थे सह कन्यया॥
en: The only boon that I ask for, O lord, is that I may have a grandson by her.” Having taken that girl with them Galava with the bird,

sa: विकिरन् ब्राह्मणं युद्धे बहुभिर्निशितैः शरै। अभ्यापतदमेयात्मा गौतमस्य रथं प्रति॥
en: Having covered in battle the Brahmana with sharp arrows, that one of immeasurable energy, advanced towards the car of Gautama's son.

sa: मान्धाता यत्र राजर्षिर्यत्र राजा भगीरथः। दौष्यन्तियत्र भरतस्तत्र त्वं विहरिष्यसि॥
en: Sharing the blissful region acquired by the royal sage Mandhatri, king Bhagiratha, Dushyanta's son Bharata, you will sport there in bliss.

sa: विषमुद्बन्धनं वापि प्रवेशं ज्वलनस्य वा। उपवासमथो शस्त्रं प्रचरिष्यन्ति वानराः॥
en: The monkeys shall take poison, or hang themselves, or enter into flaming fire, or fast, or fall on their own weapons.

sa: यत्र सा बृहती श्यामा बुद्धिसत्त्वगुणान्विता। द्रौपदी योषितां श्रेष्ठा यत्र चैव गता मम॥
en: I wish to go there where that foremost of women, Draupadi, of ample proportions and darkish complexion and gifted with great intelligence and righteousness of conduct, has gone!'

sa: ततस्तु शूराः समरे नरेन्द्र नरेश्वरं प्राप्य युधां वरिष्ठम्। आवार्य चैनं समरे नृवीरा जघ्नुः शरैः पत्रिभिरुग्रवेगैः॥
en: Then those heroes, O king, having obtained the king of the Madras, that best of warriors in battle, opposed that first of men in that encounter and began to strike him with powerful winged arrows.

sa: एकांशो वासवं यातु द्वितीयो वज्रमेव तु। तृतीयो भूतलं यातु तदा वृत्रं हनिष्यति॥
en: Of those three portions the first will stay in Indra, second into thunderbolt and the third one into the earth, then he will be able to slay him.

sa: भूयो बन्धाद्विमुक्तेन भाषयित्वा दशाननम्। लङ्का भस्मीकृता येन पावकेनेव मेदिनी॥
en: Being released from the Brahma weapon Hanuman remonstrated with Rāvaņa, and reduced Larkā into ashes like to fire burning down earth.

sa: गृहस्थं हि सदा देवाः पितरोऽतिथयस्तथा। भृत्याश्चैवोपजीवन्ति तान् भरस्व महीपते॥
en: The gods, Pitris, guests, and servants all depend (for their maintenance) upon householder. Do you then support all these, O king.

sa: शौनक उवाच कोऽपराधो महेन्द्रस्य कः प्रमादश्च सूतज। तपसा वालखिल्यानां संभूतो गरुडः कथम्॥
en: Shaunaka said: O son of Suta, what was the fault of Indra and what was his carelessness? How was Garuda born owing to the penances of the Valakhilyas?

sa: अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषीतोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे। तदेव मे दर्शय देवरूपं प्रसीद देवेश जगनिवास॥
en: Seeing your this form unseen before, I have been delighted, but my mind has been frightened. Show me your ordinary form. O God. Be gracious, O Lord of the gods, O Refuge of the universe

sa: तत्र तां प्रवणामेव मातरं क्षौमवासिनीम्। वाग्यतां देवतागारे ददर्शायाचतीं श्रियम्॥
en: There, Rāma found his mother in the temple, clad in silk, adoring the gods, and silently praying for his royal luck.

sa: इत्युक्ते युयुधानेन पूजयामास तद्वचः। प्रद्युम्नो रथिनां श्रेष्ठो हार्दिक्यमवमन्य च॥
en: When Yuyudhana had said these words, Pradyumna, that foremost of car-warriors, applauded them, expressing his disregard for the son of Hridika.

sa: तां हतां भीमसंकाशां दृष्ट्वा सुरपतिस्तदा॥ साधु साध्विति काकुत्स्थं सुराश्चाप्यभिपूजयन्।
en: Upon seeing that grim-visaged one slain, the lord of the celestials together with the celestials themselves honouring Kākutstha, exclaimed Well, Well!.

sa: अवष्टब्धं च मे राम नक्षत्रं दारुणग्रहैः। आवेदयन्ति दैवज्ञाः सूर्याङ्गारकराहुभिः॥
en: The astrologers say that the star of my life has been invaded by those terrible planets, the Sun, Mars, and Rāhu.
